long_biography.plain_text:
Jhonlin Group grew from the contracting company Haji Isam established after two years inside Johan Maulana's mining business. His first work for PT Arutmin Indonesia gave the new contractor an operating foothold. He established CV Jhonlin Baratama in 2004, converting it into PT Jhonlin Baratama as contracts expanded the following year.

Isam paired extraction with the transport required to move coal from South Kalimantan. Jhonlin developed dedicated aviation and marine businesses around its mining operations. Jhonlin Marine manages a large barge fleet for coal cargo, while Jhonlin Air Transport supplies the group's aviation capacity.
